what_it_does: Develops a wearable haptic system to help visually impaired students understand spatial and geometric concepts. The system includes a 15×15 grid touch screen made from pressure-sensitive materials and copper strips, a wearable glove with five coin vibration motors, and a cloud-based system that translates touch inputs into haptic feedback patterns. Real-time feedback enables dynamic exploration of shapes and spatial relationships that traditional tactile graphics cannot provide.
